notes.content:
- Texts have been improved.
- Graphics have been enhanced — including minigames, inventory items, and location details.
- Some animations have been adjusted for a smoother experience.

- The mechanics of the statue minigame have been refined for a more convenient experience.

notes.title: Update for True Fear: Forsaken Souls Bundle Players
notes.content:
We’ve recently made an important update to the True Fear: Forsaken Souls Bundle. The issue affecting access to Part 1 has now been resolved for all future buyers.

Unfortunately, several users had already purchased the bundle before we noticed the mistake. If you're one of them and are having trouble accessing Part 1, please reach out to us at support@goblinz.com — we’ll be happy to help. As a token of apology for the inconvenience, we’ll provide a free key to affected players.

Thank you for your understanding and support!

notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
Bonus Content:
 - High-resolution wallpapers have been added to the Bonus section.

Bug Fixes:
 - For those who haven't seen it, an issue related to the Playroom and Key has been fixed.
 - Fixed minor mini-game bugs in both the gameplay and Replay sections. Including a bug fix - the final state in the Statues minigame.

Optimization:
 - General performance optimizations have been implemented.

Analytics:
 - New events have been added to support future updates (all data is anonymous).

Text Improvements:
 - Various in-game texts have been improved for clarity and consistency.

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: True Fear: Forsaken Souls Part 3 – Play It Now!
notes.content:
Dear friends,

True Fear: Forsaken Souls Part 3 is finally out - and we’re incredibly grateful for your support and reviews! 

We’re reading every single one and carefully tracking all reported issues.

We’ve fixed the bug that blocked the Mac release - it should now be live. Apologies for the delay!
Today’s update also addresses several reported bugs, and we’re actively working on the rest.

We’re preparing new language support - including Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Polish, Portuguese... - and currently proofreading the existing translations to improve quality.

Thank you so much for your patience and encouragement.
You’ve been our inspiration every step of the way. 

— The Goblinz Team

notes.title: True Fear: Forsaken Souls Part 3 Demo – Play It Now!
notes.content:
The True Fear: Forsaken Souls Part 3 Demo has been waiting for you… but have you dared to play it?

Join us for a special live stream, where we’ll step into the darkness, face sinister mysteries, and experience the fear together. Whether you’ve played the demo before or are seeing it for the first time, this is your chance to get a taste of the horror before the full game launches on March 31!
